baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for '/revoke' endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The '/revoke' endpoint does not have any authentication or authorization checks. It is exposed to anyone who can make a request to it, which could lead to unauthorized revocation of tokens or other sensitive operations.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The '/revoke' endpoint does not have any authentication checks. It is exposed to anyone who can make a request to it, which could lead to unauthorized revocation of tokens or other sensitive operations.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: route handler; required control: authentication
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check to ensure that only authenticated users can access this endpoint. This could be done using middleware like 'passport.authenticate' or by checking for a valid session token in the request headers.

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for /profile endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /profile endpoint is exposed without any authentication checks. Any authenticated user can access this endpoint to retrieve another user's profile information.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The /profile endpoint does not have any authentication checks in place. It is exposed without requiring a valid JWT token, allowing any authenticated user to access another user's profile information.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: GET /authentication/profile Header { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }; required control: authentication
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add authentication middleware to the /profile endpoint to ensure only authorized users can access it. For example: router.get('/profile', passport.authenticate('jwt', { session: false }), async (req, res) => { ... })

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for /login/2fa-verify endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /login/2fa-verify endpoint does not have any authentication or authorization checks. It is exposed to anyone who can make a request to it, which could lead to unauthorized access.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., passport.authenticate) is present in the evidence or shown callers for the /login/2fa-verify endpoint. The operation requires authentication to ensure that only authenticated users can access it.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: route handler; required control: authentication
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check, such as `passport.authenticate('jwt', { session: false })`, before handling requests to the /login/2fa-verify endpoint.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for 2FA setup send operation
baseline_findings.description: The `/2fa/setup-send` endpoint does not have any authentication or authorization checks. This could allow an attacker to send a 2FA code to any user's account, potentially compromising their account security.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The operation is a route handler that sends a 2FA code. It requires authentication to ensure that only the owner of the account can send a 2FA code, but no such check is present in the evidence or shown callers.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: route handler; required control: authentication
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check to ensure that only authenticated users can access this endpoint. This could be done using middleware like `passport.authenticate('jwt')` to verify the user's JWT token before allowing them to send a 2FA code.
